§ 01 · The Program

Real people,
real decisions.

From recruiting top talent and handling harassment complaints, to managing layoffs ethically, building an inclusive culture, and aligning HR strategy with business goals, every scenario drops you into a genuine HR situation and asks one question: what should you actually do? Forty-eight foundations-focused scenarios and fifty-two strategy-and-employee-relations-focused scenarios, covered systematically, one real decision at a time.

01

Built for real HR judgment

Every scenario mirrors an actual situation an HR or talent management professional faces — never abstract, never artificial.

02

Systematic, complete coverage

A full set of 100 scenarios across recruiting, onboarding, performance, culture, employee relations, and workforce strategy.

03

Auto-graded

Instant scoring with clear, encouraging feedback after every exercise.

04

Genuine decision-making practice

Real situations with one best-practice response and three realistic missteps — not vocabulary drills, but sound HR judgment under real workplace pressure.

§ 02 · 100 Scenarios

scenario.

§ 03 · The Author

Brice Gadou

Business English & HR Coach

Brice Gadou is a business English specialist dedicated to helping HR and talent management professionals think clearly under pressure in a second language. Mr. Gad reflects his belief that real fluency in HR isn't reciting phrases — it's reading a situation correctly and choosing the right response, in the moment.

Designed for B1–C1 learners who already work in, or aspire to work in, HR and talent management roles in English — Mr. Gad Human Resources & Talent Management is more than a language course. It's a working rehearsal for the people moments you'll actually face.
